name: Sea Glass
description: An 8 by 8 beach of sea-glass shapes. Swap neighbours to line up three or more, and a calm round of 25 swaps. Colours also differ by shape. A board each day, or a new one whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: An 8 by 8 beach of six kinds of sea glass: round, diamond, triangle, square, hexagon and star, each with its own colour. A round is 25 swaps.
help.goal: Swap two neighbouring pieces so that three or more of a kind line up. They clear, the pieces above fall, and new ones arrive. See how high a score you can reach in 25 swaps. There is no timer.
howToPlay: Move to a piece and press Enter to pick it up.
Press an arrow key to swap it with the neighbour in that direction. Only swaps that make a line of three or more are allowed.
Cleared pieces score points, and chains of new lines score a little more each step.

If no swap is left, the glass is gently reshuffled. When the 25 swaps are used the round is complete. Today's board is the same for everyone today. New board deals a fresh one, and Restart replays the same one.

controls.action: Move the cursor, or swap once a piece is picked up
Pick up a piece, or put it back
Reach Restart, Today's board and New board

tips: Look for a gap that two pieces of one kind are waiting to fill.
Lines at the bottom shake the whole board, which can start a chain.
Shapes differ as well as colours, so you can play without telling colours apart.
You can stop at any time. Your round is saved and waits for you.
